ideas.title: Florida Bar's handling of Lindsey Halligan investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the Florida Bar's initial claim that Lindsey Halligan was under investigation and the subsequent reversal.
ideas.angle: Transparency and potential biases in the Florida Bar's investigations
questions: What led to the initial claim?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential issues with the Florida Bar's handling of investigations and their transparency.
